title: Dispatch: repair Sol S4 (stamp escapes an aborted enclosing registry unit) and S5 (release transaction wording) for PR #711 (attempt 3)
description:
Repair the fresh full Sol review eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.8.4 (bd show it: S4 material, S5 non-material) on PR #711, branch eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.8 (head 2e055e0c). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.8.5, branch eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.8.5 cut from eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.8.
S4 DESIGN (Captain): the six campaign-stamp-producing custody operations (checkout, sync-back, release, acquire idle and already-held, catch-up) must FAIL CLOSED when called while the registry connection is already inside a transaction (an enclosing atomically or any outer transaction): add a read-only way to ask the registry store whether it is in a transaction (better-sqlite3 db.inTransaction) and refuse with CharacterCustodyError BEFORE any registry or campaign write. Registry-only operations (appendRevision, register, fork, other non-stamping uses of atomically) keep supporting nesting. Document this on the atomically contract and in the capability inventory. Do not try to defer stamps to an outer commit hook.
S5: correct deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts (~l.2408) to say the revision append, chronicle append and custody clear run in one registry transaction when the chronicle store shares the registry connection (the production CLI store does), with the campaign stamp written after that commit as a separate store; no blanket promise for a chronicle store on another connection.
EVIDENCE: one generalized test over all six stamping operations: invoked inside an enclosing registry.atomically they refuse, and neither the registry head nor the campaign stamp changes; plus a registry-only nested append still works. Keep existing tests. Implementer: Claude Sonnet 5.5.
notes: Built: CharacterRegistryStore.inTransaction() (db.inTransaction, read-only); assertNotInRegistryTransaction guard at top of checkout, syncBack, release, acquireCustodyOnResume, catchUp (CharacterCustodyError before any write); atomically contract documents the restriction; inventory exclusions updated. S5: inventory now says append/chronicle/custody clear are one registry transaction when the chronicle store shares the registry connection, campaign stamp after commit, no promise for other-connection chronicle stores. Files: core/src/character/characterCustody.ts, characterRegistry.ts, rules/deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts, test/characterCustody.test.ts. Test: it.each over all six stamping ops inside registryA.atomically refuse and head/revisions/custody/stamp/sheet unchanged, plus registry-only nested append and outer-abort rollback still work. verify:worktree passed (394 files passed, 7386 tests). Commit cfbb47cf. Not pushed.
